$description: Carousel (platform/components/Carousel), library wave 8, lane B: its component tokens. The gap between slides and the peek of the next one, the controls row, the page dots (the iOS page control’s roles: the current page in the default content color, the others in the strong border color) with their 24px targets, the focus outlines and the autoplay interval.

carousel-peek.$description: Carousel: how much of the next slide shows with several per view (size-40px).

carousel-slide-min.$description: Carousel: the least width of a slide with several per view; a narrower strip shows fewer at once (size-152px).

carousel-controls-gap.$description: Carousel: gap between the strip and the controls (space-stack-sm).

carousel-dot-target.$description: Carousel: a page dot’s target size (WCAG 2.5.8) (size-24px).

carousel-dot-target-radius.$description: Carousel: a page dot target’s corner radius (its focus outline) (radius-control).

carousel-dot-radius.$description: Carousel: a page dot’s corner radius (round at its size) (radius-pill-4px).

carousel-dot-hover-background.$description: Carousel: page dot color on hover (content-muted).

carousel-dot-focus-outline-color.$description: Carousel: page dot focus outline color (focus-ring-color).

carousel-dot-focus-outline-width.$description: Carousel: page dot focus outline width (focus-ring-width).

carousel-dot-focus-outline-offset.$description: Carousel: page dot focus outline offset (focus-ring-offset).

carousel-autoplay-interval.$description: Carousel: how long a page shows before autoplay moves on (read by the component) (6s).
